question: Can P1 closed Hilbert-space geometry reduce the residual state-selection freedom on the lifted scalar-bridge carrier h_vec?

executive_verdict.summary: Yes, P1 adds theorem-grade restrictions, but it does not make the full carrier state finite or unique.

p1_restrictions.effect: forces a discrete pure-point coexact Hodge spectrum with finite shell multiplicities
removes exact and harmonic one-form sectors from the coexact carrier; H1(S3)=0
forces covariance blocks to be scalar on irreducible coexact shells by Schur's lemma
reduces admissible residual covariance to functional calculus of the coexact Hodge Laplacian, modulo smoothing terms
constrains high-shell behavior so residual differences are rapidly decaying smoothing shell tails
requires residual covariance increments to satisfy B DeltaG B^dagger = 0, preventing native A_s tuning

theorems.name: Closed-Geometry Residual Shell Classification
theorems.claim: Every geometrically admissible residual state on h_vec is represented, up to bridge-null equivalence, by a positive shell-functional covariance on the coexact S3 Hodge tower whose residual increments are rapidly decaying smoothing tails invisible to the scalar-amplitude bridge compression.
chain: Paper 31 Bridge-Quotient Theorem and C2q rank-one quotient closure

theorems.name: Closed Geometry Does Not Make the Residual Finite
theorems.claim: The closed-geometry restrictions of Theorem 27.G6 do not reduce the residual state-selection freedom to a finite-dimensional set or a unique covariance. Infinitely many rapidly decaying shell-tail perturbations remain.
chain: infinite coexact shell tower on S3
existence of infinitely many compactly supported smooth spectral tails

remaining_open_routes.name: Full geometric KMS generator theorem
remaining_open_routes.would_close_if: the complete physical lifted-carrier dynamics are proved to be H_full = c sqrt(Delta_coex) and the state is beta_H KMS for that generator

remaining_open_routes.name: Hartle-Hawking restriction theorem
remaining_open_routes.would_close_if: the exterior Hartle-Hawking-Israel quasifree state is proved to restrict uniquely to h_vec with the required coexact carrier embedding

remaining_open_routes.name: Joint observable exhaustion theorem
remaining_open_routes.would_close_if: the intersection of kernels of all active IO observables is proved to be gauge/null only

remaining_open_routes.name: Full quotient-collapse theorem
remaining_open_routes.would_close_if: h_vec modulo the joint-null sector of active observables is proved finite-dimensional or rank-one

must_not_overclaim: Do not claim P1 fixes the full quasifree covariance on h_vec.
Do not claim the residual state freedom is finite.
Do not claim the residual shell-tail freedom can tune native A_s.
Do not claim full C2c state selection is closed by closed geometry alone.
